title: River Pals Sail
description: Send color-coded animal boats out of a crowded harbor pier so waiting passengers can board their matching vessel and set sail.
controls: Tap unblocked colored boats to move them to the boarding dock where matching animal passengers climb aboard.

zh-CN.title: 动物排队上船
zh-CN.description: 海内外飙升榜爆款 Bus Jam 港口版：调度挤在码头的各色小船驶向登船位，接走对应颜色排队的萌宠乘客扬帆起航。
zh-CN.controls: 点击前方无阻挡的彩色小船驶入码头停泊位，对应颜色的小动物会自动登船，坐满即发船清空。
